sql.query: SELECT m.moduleCode,m.moduleName,CAST(CASE WHEN m.isActive=1 AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) AND (tm.accessStartDate IS NULL OR tm.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tm.accessEndDate IS NULL OR tm.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNSIGNED) hasAccess,COALESCE(tm.status,'DISABLED') status,tm.trialEndsDate FROM tbl_modules m LEFT JOIN tbl_tenant_modules tm ON tm.moduleId=m.id AND tm.tenantId=:tenantId WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:membershipTenant AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY m.displayOrder,m.moduleName

SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='LOCATIONS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:tenantId AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) AND (tm.accessStartDate IS NULL OR tm.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tm.accessEndDate IS NULL OR tm.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:membershipTenant AND utr.isActive=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNSIGNED) hasAccess

SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:tenantId AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))) AND (tm.accessStartDate IS NULL OR tm.accessStartDate<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tm.accessEndDate IS NULL OR tm.accessEndDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:membershipTenant AND utr.isActive=1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNSIGNED) hasAccess
